title: Organiser v2 migration scope
question: Forms gallery, image gallery, and settings move into the Honest Clubhouse world under /organiser/v2. Pick the migration shape that matches what you want shipped.

options.label: List pages only — match hub
options.thesis: Port the three catalogue/settings screens into v2 chrome; form editor, crop modal, and Stripe setup keep working via the same services.
options.viewport: Same header + panel language as Event collections / Custom links; sidebar points at the new routes.
options.risk: Drilldowns and create-form still live on legacy paths until a later pass.

options.label: List pages + legacy redirects
options.thesis: Same as list-only, and old /organiser/forms/gallery, /organiser/gallery, /organiser/settings redirect to v2.
options.viewport: Bookmarks and sidebar both land on the new surfaces with no dual URLs.
options.risk: Anyone sharing old links still lands correctly, but you cannot A/B the two UIs.

options.label: Full forms + gallery + settings subtree
options.thesis: Also restyle form create/editor/preview shells and gallery upload chrome under v2 routes in this pass.
options.viewport: End-to-end v2 paths for forms and gallery, not just the catalogue screens.
options.risk: Much larger scope; editor UX is a separate operate surface and may dilute the hub consistency win.
